annotations.title: Change how the pages look, through the print rules, and see them.

description: Changes any line of the book’s style file, for every page or for one person, and returns what was set, what a print rule changed with its reason, what was refused with its reason, and pictures of the pages as they now print. A path is a part and a property, such as codes.size_mm, codes.align, words.size_pt, heading.italic, photo.grayscale, ink or margins_mm.top; get_style lists them all. Ask for what the person wants in their words, one change per line. Examples: the founder’s test, the code smaller and on the right only, is [{path:"codes.size_mm",value:15},{path:"codes.align",value:"right"},{path:"codes.which",value:"voice"}]. Niamh’s pages in green ink is [{path:"ink",value:"#1F4D2B",person:"Niamh"}]. reset: true puts the September page back.

changes.description: Each change: path (a part and a property, as get_style lists them), value, and person when it is for one person’s pages only.

reset.description: true takes every change off, back to the September page, before any changes listed.
